text: Seabrook Town conseguiu uma incrível virada sobre Harbour City, vencendo por 4 a 2 na Northbridge League [#905]. Apesar do jogador de Seabrook, Joon Whitfield, ter sido expulso aos 43 minutos [#871], o time conseguiu dominar o segundo tempo, criando chances mais reais de gol, com uma xG (chances reais de gol) de 3.1 contra 0.48 do adversário [#1882] [#1448]. Marek Barros, do Harbour City, foi destaque com um gol, duas assistências e nota máxima, mostrando muito talento [#975]. Os gols finais foram um show, com Kian Romano marcando dois gols seguidos no tempo de acréscimos, ambos com grandes chances (xG de 0.745 e 0.956), completando a virada impressionante [#1882] [#1906]. A tática do Seabrook mudou no segundo tempo para pressionar mais e jogar de forma mais direta, o que resultou em gols rápidos saindo de contra-ataques após recuperar a bola [#1361] [#1448]. A partida mostrou uma batalha intensa e emocionante até o último minuto.

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in pt

- Seabrook Town won with a final score of 4-2 over Harbour City. [#905]
- Marek Barros (Harbour City) scored with an xG of 0.185 and had 2 assists and a rating of 10.0. [#975]
- Seabrook Town dominated second-half xG and shots: 3.1 xG from 13 shots compared to Harbour City's 0.48 xG from 5 shots. [#1882, #1448]
- Kian Romano scored twice in stoppage time (90+2', 90+3') with high xG events of 0.745 and 0.956. [#1882, #1906]
- Joon Whitfield (Seabrook Town) received a red card at 43', but Seabrook still came back to win. [#871]

- Harbour City scored their first goal after a prolonged patient short passing sequence involving 17 passes over nearly a minute, displaying their 4-2-3-1 formation's emphasis on controlled build-up and possession retention, culminating in a through pass assist by Marek Barros to Elias Okafor in a very high xG chance (0.994) [904,905].
- Marek Barros's second goal for Harbour City came from a quick set-piece scenario—a corner and a subsequent short sequence including a cross from Barros himself—highlighting an exploitation of set piece opportunities in line with their patient, possession-oriented style [973,975].
- Seabrook Town exploited turnovers and quick regains to create goal-scoring opportunities, such as Tariq Marlowe's rapid strike just after a regain with no additional passes, demonstrating their 3-4-3 formation’s ability to press and launch quick transitions, consistent with their wide, crossing play style [1103,1104].
- After falling behind, Seabrook Town adjusted tactically, increasing their press intensity, directness, and line height to chase the game. Their goals following this change involved quick regains and swift build-up featuring few passes (e.g., Callum Varga's goal after 3 passes in 16 seconds starting from a regain), reflecting an effective counter-attacking and pressing trap pattern from their wide 3-4-3 setup [1361,1447,1448].
- The late goals by Kian Romano originated from rapid counter-attacks initiated by regains and quick through balls with minimal pass sequences, illustrating Seabrook Town’s tactical shift to a higher press and faster, more direct play to overturn the deficit, taking advantage of Harbour City's delayed tactical change in pressing and directness [1881,1882,1884,1905,1906].
